description: Build a reproducible 100M Chinese-first single-GPU pretraining, Muon A/B, SFT, and generation lab.

userStories.title: Bootstrap repository and environment doctor
userStories.description: As an operator, I want safe packaging, configs, Git guards, and an environment doctor so that unsupported machines fail before training.
acceptanceCriteria: Doctor reports required runtime and hardware capabilities
Strict doctor blocks unsupported training
Packaging, license, ignore rules, and focused tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Strict WSL2 doctor passed on Python 3.12, torch 2.13 CUDA, RTX 4060 Ti, BF16 and Muon.

userStories.title: Add validated configuration and 100M model
userStories.description: As a researcher, I want typed configuration and a readable decoder model so that the architecture is explicit.
acceptanceCriteria: Strict YAML config round-trips
Default model has 99–102M parameters and tied weights
Model shape, causality, RoPE, loss, and backward tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Default model is 100,289,280 parameters; CPU and compiled CUDA forwards/backwards passed.

userStories.title: Train and evaluate a fixed-ID SentencePiece tokenizer
userStories.description: As a researcher, I want a Chinese-first byte-fallback tokenizer so that text maps reproducibly to vocabulary IDs.
acceptanceCriteria: Tokenizer has 24,576 pieces and fixed special IDs
Tokenizer metrics and local fixture tests pass
No test downloads data
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Fixed seven-token ID contract, byte fallback, train-only corpus bridge and metrics are covered by local tests.

userStories.title: Prepare deterministic packed training data
userStories.description: As a researcher, I want pinned sources and packed uint32 shards so that training and validation are reproducible.
acceptanceCriteria: 80/10/10 source manifests record revisions and licenses
Deduplication and hash split precede tokenization
Packing, shard reading, and cursor tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Pinned manifests include 80/10/10 requested token counts; dedupe, split, uint32 packing and cursor tests pass.

userStories.title: Implement Muon/AdamW training and scheduling
userStories.description: As a researcher, I want explicit optimizer ownership and a stable accumulated step so that Muon can be compared fairly.
acceptanceCriteria: Optimizer groups are exhaustive and disjoint
Muon/AdamW settings and warmup-cosine match the PRD
Accumulation and failure tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Official Muon and AdamW ownership, accumulation, BF16 checks and cosine scheduling passed CPU and CUDA tests.

userStories.title: Add atomic checkpoints and local monitoring
userStories.description: As an operator, I want checkpoints and local metrics so that long runs recover without hidden state loss.
acceptanceCriteria: Atomic complete checkpoints and retention are implemented
JSONL and optional TensorBoard metrics are implemented
Resume and retention tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Atomic retention and full RNG/optimizer/data resume pass on CPU and CUDA; MFU and temperature telemetry are wired.

userStories.title: Enforce the A/B gate and evaluation workflow
userStories.description: As a researcher, I want a deterministic short comparison so that formal Muon training requires evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: A/B controls and thresholds match the PRD
Only one bounded Muon calibration is allowed
Budget and gate tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Gate, bounded LR calibration, held-out evaluation and aligned 120-hour token budget tests pass.

userStories.title: Add COIG SFT and deterministic generation
userStories.description: As a learner, I want instruction tuning and generation so that the base-to-chat path is demonstrable.
acceptanceCriteria: COIG train/validation selection is deterministic
Assistant-only labels and SFT defaults match the PRD
Generation and SFT tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Deterministic 50K/1K selection, response-only loss, AdamW SFT and seeded generation tests pass.

userStories.title: Complete CLI, documentation, and residue guards
userStories.description: As an operator, I want end-to-end commands and repository audits so that I can run safely without leaking artifacts.
acceptanceCriteria: All planned CLI commands and docs exist
Tracked-file audit rejects forbidden artifacts
Ralph dry-run and aggregate validation pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Full CLI, docs, tracked-file audit and Ralph dry-run pass; Windows CPU and WSL CUDA aggregate suites are green.
